## Ultimate customization for Dynamic Island
Bring notifications into Dynamic Island, then customize its colors, opacity, position, size, content, and behavior.

views.markdown:
- Display notifications with app or contact imagery, message content, and supported attachments
- Configure tap, long-press, and swipe actions
- Choose static, dynamic, random, or per-activity colors
- Adjust opacity, position, size, outline, glow, spacing, and content appearance
- Allow or block individual apps and activity types

For full details and purchase information, please visit the [official website](https://m4fn3.github.io/repo/web/K2geIsland.html).

## 1.0.1 - 2026-06-10
- Added notifications inside Dynamic Island.
- Added configurable notification gestures, appearance, duration, content, and haptic feedback.

## 1.0.0 - 2024-08-15
- Initial release with Dynamic Island color, size, position, content, and activity customization.
